headline: Hair that feels like you, only better.
intro: Cuts, colour, braids and treatments in a calm, unhurried studio. Book a chair on WhatsApp in a minute.
services_title: Everything your hair needs, under one roof.
service_1_desc: Precision cuts and blow-dries shaped to your face, your texture and how you actually wear your hair.
service_2_desc: From a subtle gloss to a full transformation, with a strand test and an honest conversation first.
service_3_desc: Knotless, cornrows, twists and wig installs, done neatly and kind to your edges.
service_4_desc: Deep conditioning and scalp care that bring dry, tired or damaged hair back to life.
work_1_caption: Soft layers and a glossy finish
step_1_desc: Tell us what you'd like on WhatsApp. A photo of the look you love helps.
step_2_desc: We'll confirm a slot that suits you, plus the price and how long it takes.
step_3_desc: Arrive, relax and leave with hair you can't stop touching.
about_text: We take the time to understand your hair before we touch it. No rushing, no surprises on the bill, just good work in a space that feels like a breather from the week.
faq_1_a: WhatsApp us with the service you want and a preferred day. We'll reply with available times.
faq_2_a: When the diary allows. Messaging first is the surest way to get a chair.
faq_3_a: It depends on length and what you're after. Send a photo and we'll give you a price before you come in.
